frequency_question: What proportion of major Union Ministry industrial subsidy/financing schemes are formally finalized and notified within a 343-day policy-to-notification timeframe from conceptualization to gazette notification?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes involving financial subsidies, credit guarantees, and inter-ministerial consultations (Finance, Heavy Industries, Expenditure) initiated and completed within recent years. Excludes minor administrative circulars or schemes pushed solely via executive fiat without financial outlays.
